description: Find companies tracked by techjobs.vn by name, with their number of open jobs and referrers. Use to look up a company's slug, then get_company for its profile or search_jobs for its jobs.

limit.description: Maximum companies to return (default 10): up to 10 without sign-in, 50 when signed in.

page.description: Page of `limit` results, starting at 1; up to page 3 without sign-in.

query.description: Part of the company name or slug, e.g. "grab". Omit to list companies with the most open jobs.

name: search_companies
title: Search companies hiring in Vietnam
